experiment: GATE LOOP V3 — ControlNet-scribble from dicebear edges
thesis: Structure constraint (scribble-CN on the dicebear edge map) fights the DreamShaper anthropomorphization bias better than prompt steering did (v2: falsified, effect -1.26 the wrong way), while keeping identity survival non-inferior. The dicebear line art is the identity anchor; the CN map pins geometry directly instead of hoping the prompt says the right words.

grid.cn_source: PIL FIND_EDGES of dicebear 512px render, inverted (white lines on black), autocontrast

claims.claim: CN arms mean CLIP identity >= 0.82 per subject (non-inferiority vs v2 base arm 0.882, minus margin)
CN arms edge-IoU (gen vs dicebear source, 128px binary) beats base arm, paired per seed, both subjects
CN arm machine_vs_organic bias magnitude < base arm's, AND >=1 CN survivor with corrected L1 <= 5.0 and identity >= 0.80

honest_fail_allowed: Any or all claims may FAIL; verdicts recorded either way, no re-rolls.
machinery: gate_v2.py cascade reused: DreamShaper8+LCM 6-step, CLIP-b32 identity, moondream->qwen2.5:3b dial quantization, per-arm bias decomposition, typesafe jev-latest noul on survivors
